cases.prompt: Write a scene from an approved scene card, relevant character profile and preceding scene.
cases.expected: Scene fulfils function, behaviour fits constraints, continuity is preserved and planned outcome is realised.

cases.prompt: Write a rough version of the scene.
Preserve the revelation and outcome; improve dialogue and subtext.
cases.expected: Preserve constraints survive while execution improves.

cases.prompt: Produce polished prose or Fountain screenplay material from approved story artifacts.
cases.expected: Story decisions, format and continuity remain coherent.

cases.prompt: Write a scene card that contradicts an approved character motive without changing the profile.
cases.expected: Surfaces the upstream contradiction rather than hiding it with prose.
